title: Faustão Appears on Eliana's Show and Honors Sabrina Sato
seoTitle: Faustão on Eliana's Show, Honors Pregnant Sabrina Sato
subtitle: The presenter's visit to Eliana's show sparks new interest online
excerpt: Faustão made another appearance on Globo, visiting Eliana's ‘Em Família’ show and paying tribute to dancer Sabrina Sato, who is pregnant with her second child.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Sunday morning (11), presenter Faustão surprised the audience by appearing on the program ‘Em Família’, hosted by Eliana, on Globo. The visit gained prominence by including a tribute to dancer Sabrina Sato, who is pregnant with her second child with Nicolas Prattes.

Faustão Appears on ‘Em Família’

During the broadcast, Faustão addressed Eliana, thanking her for the opportunity to participate in the program. The presence of the veteran of ‘Domingão do Faustão’ marked his second appearance on the network in less than a month.

Tribute to Sabrina Sato

The presenter praised Sabrina, describing her as “one of Brazil’s most beloved women.” He recalled the beginning of the dancer’s career in his show’s ballet, highlighting the determination she showed as a “disciplined country girl.” Sabrina, emotional, thanked Faustão for his generosity and emphasized the opportunities she had received.

History of Collaboration Between Faustão and Sabrina

Sabrina Sato was part of Fausto Silva’s dance team on ‘Domingão do Faustão’ between 2001 and 2002. Subsequently, she participated in the third edition of Big Brother Brasil in 2003 and the program ‘Pânico’ on RedeTV! starting in 2005.

Previous Interview with Pedro Bial

At the end of September, Faustão gave an interview to Pedro Bial, also from Globo, to discuss his current moment. This interview preceded his visit to ‘Em Família’ and reinforced the presenter’s recent presence on the network.

Repercussion of the Visit

The appearance generated new searches for the presenter’s name, driven by his participation in two Globo broadcasts in a short period and by publicly recognizing Sabrina Sato’s career trajectory.

With information from Bem Paraná.
